_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_kaydee: Last Call

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The tavern is empty. Kaydee wipes the bar. Jack sits on the last stool]

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Last call was twenty minutes ago. Even you don't get special treatment.

options.text: Then why haven't you kicked me out?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Because I don't want you to go. And that's the problem.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I've got the attitude. The sharp tongue. The 'don't get too close' routine.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: It works. It's worked for years.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: But you didn't back off. You built me a brewing machine.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Nobody LISTENS. And now I'm having feelings like some kind of...

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Don't you DARE make me laugh right now. I'm being vulnerable.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Do you know how hard this is for me?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: So what are we doing here, Jack?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: You know what? I don't have a witty comeback for that.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Don't tell anyone I smiled. I have a reputation.
